provenance: Owner-authorized convention normalization; original six profiles remain pinned. Rules use actual headings/captions and formats observed in the profile, never exemplar ids or expected pass/fail counts.
abstractFormats: All structured/unstructured formats explicitly measured in a profile are permitted conventions; venue abstract rules remain authoritative.
canonicalConclusions: The literal heading Conclusions means conclusions even when a broad Discussion alias also lists it.
limitationsInsteadOfDiscussion: Only when the profile declares a variant containing limitations but no discussion/results_discussion.
compoundFigures: All matching caption panel kinds are retained; totals count physical displays once. Explicit kind attributes may contain a space-separated list.
statementMetadata: Use semantic JATS funding-group/fn-type/sec-type and role-bearing contribution groups, retaining source locators and exact text. Initials under a contribution heading count as a statement.
captionAliasRationale: CRISPR full ranked-result spreadsheets and S-table ranges are the stated top_hits_table kind; MR LD-correlation matrices document correlated-instrument sensitivity. Supplemental descriptors retain every matching kind.
